I'll admit I didn't like this game when I first tried it years ago, however this game is now amazing. It's got a high learning curve and doesnt hold your hand, however theres plenty of community help to get you started out there. Honestly it's the best game I've played in ages, after 200+ hours I've spent some real money on it, totally deserved. Given Destiny and BFII its mad a free game can give this much quality without forcing you to spend anything! Tripple AAA publishers could learn a lot.
Its pretty fun. Nice butts abound. Little grindy and sometimes the floors cant be trusted. but other than that, great game.

Love this game. Got it a few weeks ago and have been playing it too much
very addictictive and immersive

TL;DR:
Played a few hours, it's ok.
